subject: Greenline CAIQ intake: Secure SDLC evidence and next steps
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@greenline.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni
Cc: irene_choi, marissa_cole
Date: 2026-07-18T16:12:00Z
Subject: Greenline CAIQ intake: Secure SDLC evidence and next steps

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking this on. Greenline is running a CAIQ intake ahead of a third-party assessment next month and we need a focused Secure SDLC bundle from Redwood. Primary asks from our assessor: code review policy and recent PR sample artifacts, CI/CD pipeline control evidence (runner rotation, secrets handling), change management approvals for production releases, and redacted CI logs showing PR gating.

Can you confirm you can provide: 
- A single manifest listing artifacts and owners
- Redacted CI logs (last 90 days) and a sample PR/merge chronology for two recent releases
- The branch protection / PR gating policy and evidence of enforcement (e.g., failed checks, approver lists)
- Note on secrets management (ephemeral credentials, KMS usage, retention) and change approval workflow

We also need a short point-of-contact list and to schedule a 30-min intake call this week. Prefer Jul 19 in the morning PT.

Also copying our assessor mailbox (audit@greenline.com) for intake coordination.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Security Engagement Lead
Greenline Capital
[attachment: greenline-questionnaire.docx (docx, 45KB)]

From: vivek_kulkarni
To: Samir Rao <samir@greenline.com>
Cc: irene_choi, marissa_cole
Date: 2026-07-18T19:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Greenline CAIQ intake: Secure SDLC evidence and next steps

Samir —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide everything on your list. High-level plan:

1) Evidence manifest + owners (attached) — contains artifact index and redaction notes.
2) Redacted CI logs (90 days) — we will provide zipped extracts and a short sampling guide.
3) PR/merge chronology — we will provide two representative release threads with review timestamps and approver IDs (redacted where needed).
4) Branch protections & gating — policy doc plus enforcement snapshots (policy audit).
5) Secrets and KMS — short narrative + key rotation cadence and HSM/KMS references.
6) Change approvals — can provide the change ticket links and a signed attestation for process adherence.

I've attached an evidence_manifest.csv and access_instructions.md with a Drive link and temporary viewer tokens. For the intake call, Jul 19 at 10:00 AM PT works for our engineering lead (Irene) and Marissa from SOC2 program.

Next steps: if you confirm the call time I'll send a calendar invite and we will begin packaging the initial artifacts by end of day Jul 19.

Thanks — Vivek
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi
To: vivek_kulkarni, marissa_cole
Cc: rishi_malhotra
Date: 2026-07-19T17:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Greenline CAIQ intake: Secure SDLC evidence and next steps

Vivek / Marissa —

Quick technical plan and artifact list from engineering/security side (Irene):

- PR/Code review evidence:
  * pr-gate-chronology.pdf (contains two release PR timelines, reviewer IDs, timestamps, and comments with redaction).
  * Sample PR link snapshots (redacted) included in manifest.

- CI/CD controls:
  * ci-runner-rotation.log (audit log for runner certificate rotations for the last 6 months).
  * CI job definitions showing secrets usage: jobs referencing KMS-encrypted variables, no plaintext secrets in pipeline.
  * Retention policy: CI logs retained for 180 days by default; we will produce a 90-day extract per Greenline request.

- Secrets management and key custody:
  * Short memo: ephemeral credentials are issued by our internal token broker, backed by AWS KMS (CMK) with quarterly rotation. HSM-backed keys used for signing critical artifacts.
  * Access control: least-privilege roles, short TTLs for service tokens, and onboarding/offboarding automation (Jira ticket + SCM group sync).

- Change management:
  * Change tickets with approvals: we will provide the change IDs and the approval audit trail for the two releases.
  * Emergency release exceptions: documented exceptions with post-facto approvals (included if requested).

- Redactions: PII and customer data removed; we will provide a redaction manifest mapping original IDs to redaction placeholders.

I can produce the initial package by end of day Jul 19; full CI extracts will follow once Greenline confirms the NDA link and viewer token scopes.

— Irene Choi
Director, Platform Security
[attachment: pr-gate-chronology.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]
[attachment: ci-runner-rotation.log (log, 64KB)]

Vivek / Irene —

Thanks — this looks good and comprehensive. Confirming the Jul 19 intake call recap (we got the calendar invite). A few quick asks to finalize scope: 

- Please upload the initial manifest and the two redacted PR timelines to the Drive folder and grant viewer access to audit@greenline.com.
- We need a signed attestation that the artifacts are accurate and representative of normal operations (template attached). Can you provide a signed PDF attestation from your security lead?
- Our assessor also sent a short questionnaire (attached) with a handful of clarifying questions; if you can return that with references to the corresponding artifact filenames that will speed review.

If you can get the manifest + PR timelines uploaded by EOD Jul 21 and attestations by Jul 23 we'll be in good shape for the assessment window.

I'll upload our questionnaire to the Drive and share an NDA link if needed (we prefer DocuSign for attestation).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Samir
